item.title: TrollFools v4.4-257
item.description:
TrollFools 4.4-257 | TrollFools_4.4-257.tipa
允许 Dopamine 被 TrollFools 注入第三方插件，以提供自定义背景、倒计时自动越狱及其他扩展功能。
------
Allows official Dopamine to be injected by TrollFools into third-party plugins to provide custom backgrounds, automatic jailbreak countdowns, and other extended features.
